title: HPSM-POC: approve the two import messages before imports are ever switched on (HPSMPOC-267)?
bluf: Tap a to approve both texts, or reply with replacements. Nothing is urgent: imports are switched off on the hosted site (HPSMPOC-267 description; C-108 in analysis repo CLARIFICATIONS.md), so no customer can see either text today. Both are customer-visible words, which are yours (C-105). Text 1, the sweep reason: "The upload stopped before it finished, so nothing was read. Upload the files again." (ImportPendingSweep.cs:98). Text 2, the upload error: "Import {runId} is recorded as failed; its files are kept. Upload the files again." plus "The rows could not be saved." This is false for zero-row or refused-only uploads, where no rows exist and a refused file is not kept (HPSMPOC-267; gate B252 line 385). The same ruling also unblocks HPSMPOC-275 and HPSMPOC-263, which C-113 holds until the import words are decided.

options.label: Approve text 1; replace text 2 with the true sentence from the gate
options.detail: Text 1 stays as written. For text 2 the upload error uses the sweep reason instead (the gate B252 fix shape, line 420), so it is true for every upload. A seat builds the change and the words go on a normal deploy card later.

options.label: Replace both; I will send the wording
options.detail: You reply with your own sentences. The seat builds exactly those. Imports stay off.

options.label: Hold: decide when imports are about to be turned on
options.detail: Nothing is built or approved now. Imports stay off. HPSMPOC-267, -275 and -263 stay parked.

default_action: Hold (option c): imports stay off, neither text is approved, no code changes. Tuesday asks again when a task wants to switch imports on.
